commit acfeb22ea3d5333874bb62093d7fbad3fc6369e0
Author:     Vineet Deo <vineet@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Mon Apr 6 09:20:18 2026 +0000
Commit:     Vineet Deo <vineet@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Mon Apr 6 09:20:18 2026 +0000

    Bug 2028449 - Create pref for new manual config flow in account hub. r=tobyp
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D291767

diff --git a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js b/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
index 11a13ec5950..f8eac5a7055 100644
--- a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
+++ b/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
@@ -1510,9 +1510,12 @@ pref("mail.accounthub.enabled", true);
 // Enable address book setup via account hub
 pref("mail.accounthub.addressbook.enabled", true);
 
-// Enabled Thundermail ui in account hub.
+// Enable Thundermail ui in account hub.
 pref("mail.accounthub.thundermail.enabled", false);
 
+// Enable new manual config ui in account hub.
+pref("mail.accounthub.manualconfig.enabled", false);
+
 // Export to mobile logging level.
 pref("mail.qrexport.loglevel", "Warn");
 
diff --git a/mail/components/preferences/general.inc.xhtml b/mail/components/preferences/general.inc.xhtml
index 6c6acec78ad..6ef06577aa3 100644
--- a/mail/components/preferences/general.inc.xhtml
+++ b/mail/components/preferences/general.inc.xhtml
@@ -129,6 +129,13 @@
           <description data-l10n-id="account-hub-checkbox-description"
                        class="tip-caption indent"/>
         </vbox>
+        <vbox>
+          <checkbox id="accountHub"
+                    data-l10n-id="account-hub-manual-config-checkbox-label"
+                    preference="mail.accounthub.manualconfig.enabled"/>
+          <description data-l10n-id="account-hub-manual-config-checkbox-description"
+                       class="tip-caption indent"/>
+        </vbox>
       </vbox>
     </html:fieldset>
     </html:div>
diff --git a/mail/components/preferences/general.js b/mail/components/preferences/general.js
index bf7c0554e32..bff83ac28e9 100644
--- a/mail/components/preferences/general.js
+++ b/mail/components/preferences/general.js
@@ -68,6 +68,7 @@ Preferences.addAll([
   { id: "mailnews.start_page.enabled", type: "bool" },
   { id: "mailnews.start_page.url", type: "string" },
   { id: "mail.accounthub.enabled", type: "bool" },
+  { id: "mail.accounthub.manualconfig.enabled", type: "bool" },
   { id: "mail.biff.show_tray_icon", type: "bool" },
   { id: "mail.biff.play_sound", type: "bool" },
   { id: "mail.biff.play_sound.type", type: "int" },
diff --git a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/preferences/preferences.ftl b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/preferences/preferences.ftl
index 1428dbe6c88..f6f37af5a8d 100644
--- a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/preferences/preferences.ftl
+++ b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/preferences/preferences.ftl
@@ -596,6 +596,12 @@ account-hub-checkbox-label =
 
 account-hub-checkbox-description = Experimental new mail account creation flow
 
+account-hub-manual-config-checkbox-label =
+    .label = Use the new manual configuration flow in Account Hub
+    .accesskey = c
+
+account-hub-manual-config-checkbox-description = New account hub manual configuration flow
+
 new-calendar-legend = New Calendar Event Dialog
 
 new-calendar-checkbox-label =
